posts.title: encrypted DNS for pihole with dnscrypt
posts.description: At first I wanted to set up cloudflared for my pihole a la https://pimylifeup.com/raspberry-pi-cloudflare-tunnel/ . However, I realized this requires both a cloudflare account and setup of "tunnels" which I don't care to learn or sign up for (yet?). I just want to encrypt DNS traffic. Let's just use DNScrypt - this guide is really all there is to it https://docs.pi-hole.net/guides/dns/dnscrypt-pro

posts.title: ssh git.orhun.dev
posts.description: I found a dev named Orhun via an interesting blog post on HN about AI generated code: https://blog.orhun.dev/code-responsibly/ From checking out his GitHub, he's the maintainer of Ratatui, a massive tui library for Rust. I also found: ssh git.orhun.dev Pretty neat. I'd like to look into how this was done and perhaps set up a local copy on my own.
